home.intro_h: A place that lives up to its name
intro: Our two cottages occupy the ground floor of a spacious house, in the heart of a vast two-hectare estate of green meadows at the edge of the forest, in an exceptional spot known as “Vogelsgesang”, birdsong.
Typical of the Lorraine countryside, the surroundings are lush and offer a beautiful panorama in a setting of calm and serenity.
home.gites_h: Two twin houses, the same view
home.gites_lead: The same comforts on both sides. Book one, or both for a large family.

home.gite2_sub: 60 m² · 2 bedrooms · 5 guests · terrace · parking · wheelchair accessible
home.around_h: On foot from the garden, or an hour’s drive
home.around_lead: Hiking trails without crossing a road, a lake and water-sports centre 3 km away, and Metz, the Saar and Luxembourg within a day trip.
home.hosts: Gîtes de France (3 ears of corn) since 2016, Clévacances and Tourisme & Handicap labels. We speak French, English and German.
home.book_lead: No commission, with a reply within 24 hours. Linen provided, beds made on arrival, end-of-stay cleaning included.

p: Set in the heart of a vast two-hectare estate of green meadows at the edge of the forest, our two cottages occupy the ground floor of a spacious house in an exceptional spot known as “Vogelsgesang” (birdsong).
Typical of the Lorraine countryside, the surroundings are lush and offer a beautiful panorama in a setting of calm and serenity.
There are many hiking trails, reachable without crossing a road, on foot, by bike or on horseback. Horses are available for experienced riders.

gites.lead: Two similar semi-detached cottages at garden level, each with a separate entrance, private terrace and parking.
gites.common: Each cottage has a living room with fitted kitchen (oven, ceramic hob, microwave, dishwasher, washing machine, freezer), two bedrooms and a shower room with WC, adapted for guests with reduced mobility. Sleeping: four 90 cm beds that can be pushed together in the bedrooms, plus a fifth bed in the living room: 5 guests per cottage. Flat-screen TV, wifi, geothermal underfloor heating.
desc: 2 bedrooms (two 90 × 190 cm beds each) + 1 bed in the living room

autour.lead: Hiking trails start right from the cottage, with no road to cross, on foot, by bike or on horseback. Several remarkable sites are just a few kilometres away.

creutzwald-lac: Sailing, swimming, fishing and walks around the lake.
cimetiere-americain: The largest American military cemetery in Europe.
musee-mine: The pithead and the life of Lorraine’s miners.
volklingen: A UNESCO World Heritage site just across the border.
bliesbruck: A Gallo-Roman town and its baths.
pompidou-metz: Modern and contemporary art, with Metz cathedral close by.
sainte-croix: Wolves, bears, deer and bison in the Lorraine Regional Nature Park.
boucle-sarre: The spectacular bend of the Saar, seen from the Cloef viewpoint.

autour.gallery_h: Varsberg, the Warndt forest and the fields

reservation.included: Included: bed and household linen, beds made on arrival, end-of-stay cleaning, electricity and heating, wifi, pets. Deposit €300. Tourist tax extra. Credit cards and French ANCV holiday vouchers accepted.
reservation.form_p: A booking request or a question: we reply within 24 hours, by e-mail or phone.
reservation.f_note: The message goes to gitevarsberg@hotmail.com. Your details are used only to reply to you.
reservation.access_h: Getting to the Domaine du Geisberg
access: Varsberg lies between Saint-Avold and Creutzwald, 40 minutes from Metz and 30 minutes from Saarbrücken.
By car: A4 motorway (Paris–Strasbourg), exit Saint-Avold / Carling, then follow Creutzwald and Varsberg.
By train: Saint-Avold station 6 km away (Metz–Forbach regional line).
